You use the Present Perfect:
  • For something that started in the past and continues in the present.
    • Example:
    They have been in that house for a long time.

  • For something that has been done several times.
    • Example:
    We have been to that city four times!

  • For experiences up to the present.
    • Example:
    This is the best birthday party she has ever had!

  • For something that happened in the past but is relevant at the time of speaking.
    • Example:
    She can't present the project. She has lost her computer.

  • For referring to a time that is not yet finished.
    • Example:
    Have you drunk any water today?

You use the Simple Past:
  • For something that was finished at a certain period of time.
    • Example:
    Dr. Smith finished the surgery 3 hours ago.

Simple Past tense
  • Milly sat in her rocking chair by the living room window.
  • Milly picked up her bag and took one more look at her house.
  • She wanted people to find her house neat and clean when they arrived to her house.

Present Perfect tense
  • This little house has suited me perfectly.
  • The day has finally come, and I am prepared for whatever awaits me.
  • Are you concerned about the trip?
Present Perfect Continuous tense vs. Present Perfect tense

You use the Present Perfect tense to talk about a past action or an action that began in the past that is connected to the present in some way.
You can use the Present Perfect tense to talk about experiences.
When you use the Present Perfect tense, you think about the past and present together. What happened in the past is still related to what is happening now.
To emphasize the result of the action, use the simple form.
  • Has anyone called the police about the green light in the woods?

You use Present Perfect Continuous tense to describe:
  • an activity that continues for a long time
  • an activity or action that is repeated over time
These continue up to the present. You can use the Present Perfect Continuous tense when a long-continuing activity has just stopped.
To emphasize the action, use the continuous form.
  • What have the other people in the town been doing?

Present Perfect tense
  • This little house has suited me perfectly.
  • The day has finally come, and I am prepared for whatever awaits me.
  • Are you concerned about the trip?

Present Perfect Continuous tense
  • I have been anticipating this day for 75 years.
  • It has been getting harder to get around these days.
  • I have been thinking of this incredible journey since I was a girl.

images.text: The wind was blowing and dark clouds were gathered in the sky. All down the street, people were darting under umbrellas. Some were running into their homes for shelter. Milly sat in her rocking chair by the living room window. "Today is the day they are coming. It has been a long time," she thought to herself.

She slowly got up from the rocking chair. Her bones ached. “It has been getting harder to get around these days”, she thought to herself. She went to her bedroom. A bag filled with the things that she needed for the trip was sitting in the corner. Milly took off her slippers and put on a comfortable pair of shoes. “Who knows if there will be comfortable shoes where she's going?” Milly said to herself. “I have been anticipating this day for 75 years, ever since the first visitors came.”

Milly picked up her bag and took one more look at her house. Everything was just as it's always been. She wanted people to find her house neat and clean when they arrived to her house and realized that she was gone. Milly felt the excitement rise in her stomach. She left her house and closed the door behind her.  “This little house has suited me perfectly”, she whispered to herself as she locked the door. “The day has finally come, and I am prepared for whatever awaits me.”
Milly began walking down the steep, winding path towards a faint green light in the woods. Out of nowhere,  she saw faceless figures approaching her. “Are you concerned about the trip?”, they muttered simultaneously. “I have been thinking of this incredible journey since I was a girl”, she replied.
